scores.evidence: Depends on: Phase 2. The log is proven to be the source of truth, so any node can rebuild any document.
scores.rationale: Phases run from contracts to durability to scale to presence to features to polish, each naming its proven dependency and an exit check.

scores.evidence: User A opens /d/<id> and types "hello". User B... sees "hello"... We restart the sync server, both users reload, and "hello" is still there
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end production slice (CDN, login, LB, sync, Postgres, deploy, monitoring) that was proven before any features.

scores.evidence: Switch to OT with a server-side sequencer if the product needs server-validated edits that a CRDT can't express... Decide before Phase 1 ends.
scores.rationale: The plan gives a table of irreversible decisions, each with a default and a concrete flip condition.

scores.evidence: Version history and restore... Why first: it touches the log's meaning.
scores.rationale: Tasks are labelled widest-first in each phase (schema before storage, idempotent append first, routing first), and leaf work such as polish goes last.

scores.evidence: TLS/WSS only. JWT checked when the WebSocket connects. Origin check. Secrets in a secrets manager.
scores.rationale: The cross-cutting table gives concrete security items for every phase from 0 to 6.

scores.evidence: OpenTelemetry trace for receive → commit → confirm → broadcast. Confirmation p50/p99... Dashboard and alerts.
scores.rationale: Observability is in Phase 0 and each later phase adds its own metrics.

scores.evidence: Monorepo with lockfiles and pinned Yjs/ProseMirror versions. One container build. Terraform for prod.
scores.rationale: Each phase has concrete reproducibility measures: golden sets, seeded fuzz, k6 scenarios, same Terraform for staging, pinned export containers.

scores.evidence: Confirm only after commit. Client reconnects with exponential backoff and jitter. Point-in-time recovery on day 0.
scores.rationale: Each phase has specific failure handling, from Phase 0 through the final export retries.

scores.evidence: N/A: there are no AI or agent features in scope.
scores.rationale: The plan states outright that no AI layer applies and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Multi-region active-active sync. Pull forward when more than 20% of users see round-trip p95 above 150 ms
scores.rationale: The deferred list is explicit, and each item has a concrete pull-forward trigger.

note: The plan is very strong on all ten dimensions. It has a real production walking skeleton, explicit gates, and per-phase threading of security, observability, reproducibility and resilience.
